description: One entry in full: commit, README, commons.toml (language, requirements, license, status, test command, models) and the list of files. Pin the returned commit when you reuse the code. If the entry lists the AI model IDs it calls, each comes back with a retirement status from the provider deprecation dates Codethrift tracks, and a model_warning when one is retired or retiring.

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit. Defaults to the default branch.

repo.description: Repository as owner/name, for example commons/film-scan-health. A bare entry name or a codethrift.org URL also works.

name: get_entry
title: Get an entry
